name: qlrisk_stress_test
title: Stress testing
description: Stress a book. mode='library' revalues it under qlrisk's historical crisis scenarios (1987_black_monday, 1998_ltcm_russia, 2008_gfc_lehman, 2010_euro_crisis, 2013_taper_tantrum, 2016_brexit, 2020_covid, 2022_rates_shock, 2023_regional_banks) or a chosen subset; mode='custom' under your scenarios, each a list of shocks (factor or curve twist / butterfly / parallel) or a stylised definition (equity, vol, rates, credit, fx_usd, commodity moves); mode='reverse' finds the most plausible market move (minimum Mahalanobis distance) that loses target_loss. Returns P&L per scenario and per trade, worst first. Trades take the inputs of each product's qlrisk_price_<product> tool (rates in percent, spreads in basis points, maturity as a tenor like 5Y); confidence levels are in percent (99 = 99%). Inputs: trades, mode, scenarios, custom_scenarios, target_loss; the rest (market_data, reporting_currency, history, lookback, top_n) in the optional `advanced` object. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "InterestRateSwap", "trade_id": "IRS-5Y", "maturity": "5Y", "notional": 10000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4.4, "counterparty_id": "BANK-A"}, {"product": "EquityOption", "trade_id": "SPX-P", "maturity": "6M", "notional": 1000000, "ticker": "SPX", "strike": 5000, "option_type": "put", "counterparty_id": "BANK-B"}], "mode": "library"} gives 9 stress scenario(s); worst 2008_gfc_lehman P&L -423,260.25 USD on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
